tacticalIdentity: Tank and structural engineer. Erects Bone Spires that block LoS and movement, applies BONE_ARMOR to allies for damage absorption, and debuffs enemies with BRITTLE (incoming physical damage +50%). BRITTLE + FROZEN = SHATTER (x3.75 physical damage). Highest HP of the offensive Mancer tier.
designNotes: Max 2 Bone Spire constructs simultaneously. BRITTLE + FROZEN SHATTER = x3.75 damage multiplier — highest single-hit modifier in the game. Sonimancer hard-counters bone constructs.

baseSpells.description: A physical bone projectile dealing 16 damage. The impact tile becomes OSSIFIED_GROUND (movement cost 1.5; +1 armor to adjacent units). Against BRITTLE targets: 24 damage (x1.5). Against FROZEN targets: SHATTER triggers for 40 damage (x2.5). Against BRITTLE+FROZEN: 60 damage (x3.75).
baseSpells.designNotes: Workhorse physical damage. Primary SHATTER delivery vehicle. Generates OSSIFIED_GROUND for armor bonus.

baseSpells.description: Dual-target status spell. On allies: applies BONE_ARMOR (15 flat damage absorption shield, 4-turn max duration). On enemies: applies BRITTLE (incoming physical damage +50% for 2 hits) and CALCIFIED (move -2, +15% physical armor, 2 turns).
baseSpells.designNotes: Multi-function utility. Ally = BONE_ARMOR. Enemy = BRITTLE+CALCIFIED. Decision made per cast based on tactical priority.

baseSpells.description: Melee contact dealing 8 physical damage and immediately applying BRITTLE (3 physical hits or 3 turns, whichever comes first). BRITTLE Touch BRITTLE lasts longer than Calcify BRITTLE. 1 AP makes this the cheapest BRITTLE application.
baseSpells.designNotes: Cheapest BRITTLE application. 1 AP enables same-activation BRITTLE + Bone Shard SHATTER combo.

baseSpells.description: Places a Bone Spire construct on a target tile (range 3). The Spire is 2 tiles tall (blocks LoS and movement), has 40 HP, and grants +1 physical armor to adjacent units. Units on the target tile at placement take 6 damage and are displaced 1 tile. Max 2 constructs simultaneously.
baseSpells.designNotes: Primary terrain investment. Two side-by-side Spires = 2-tile impassable bone wall with full LoS block.

baseSpells.description: Extrudes animated bone matter through an allied unit, reinforcing their frame. Ally gains 3 Bone Armor points, melee attacks deal +1 damage. Shatter condition: if ally takes 4+ damage in a single hit (after Bone Armor), lattice shatters — bone shards in 2-tile radius deal 2 damage to all units and apply BLEEDING. Duration: 3 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Defensive buff with explosive failure state. Heavy strikes shatter the lattice, damaging nearby enemies. BLEEDING counters Hydromancer regen.
